speaker: margery_pell
text: Every third man asked at my stair when the king is played. I said Thursday next and they wrote it down like a hearing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday next was the day they wrote. This is that afternoon, and the bill on the door is not the king.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. The bill is the comedy, and they have already paid me the compliment. Hear them.

speaker: (a Gray's Inn gentleman)
text: Remuneration!

speaker: will_kemp
text: There. He has it pat, and he is not the first. Let them shout. I do not mind being a returning friend, if the friend is loud.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: They have not come for thy word, Will Kemp. Look at the gowns. Gray's Inn, Lincoln's Inn, both Temples. By one the galleries were black. Some of them saw the king on Tuesday. The rest have heard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: By one I was at the lodging. I find the house already full. I am Navarre. I cannot stand in the yard and see a play I am in.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You are in it. The book has you as Navarre from the first. Do not linger on this step until your own entrance is late.

speaker: (a Gray's Inn gentleman)
text: This royall throne of Kings, this sceptred Ile. I had the rest of it on Tuesday, most of it right, I think. Is it to be printed?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's the company's, sir. Ask the book-keeper.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You have heard it. You do not buy it. Stand off the book.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He did speak it, on Tuesday. Today is not that play. The next king is Thursday the sixteenth, at two.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Every third man, and I will say the count again if the book wants it. They wrote Thursday next as if I were a clerk of their inn. I did not tell them the sixteenth. The sixteenth is the one you are telling them now.

speaker: (a Middle Temple gentleman)
text: I kept a different line. If you do wrongfully seize Hereford's rights. York, to the king. Were his council truly so careless of a dead man's will? I mean to argue it at a moot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had not thought that line a lawyer's, sir. Argue the moot where a moot is argued. I am not the council, and I am not the will. The line is the company's, the same as the other.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Stand off, I said. A speech is not a latch. You do not come in by knowing it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare, tell them the comedy before they hire you for a dead duke. I am the man they shout at. You are Navarre, if the jaw will do the vowels.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The jaw will do them once. It has been at me since the ninth of September. I am not offering a second comedy from the passage after I am done.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art Navarre till the end of this one. Do not die in the fourth for variety. Thou didst that yesterday, and on Monday.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The Rose has a bill of its own. The Grecian Comedy. A man told me on the stair, and he was not staying. He only wanted to know we were not that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are not that. I have not been to their door. Anyone who wants the king printed can ask Abel on a day when I am not due on.

speaker: (a Gray's Inn gentleman)
text: Then the book-keeper. Where do I find him after, if the door is the wrong place?

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You do not find him after. The speech stays in the play. You have heard it. That is as far as it goes.

speaker: (a Middle Temple gentleman)
text: And the will? If that is not law, it is still a question I can use. Thursday the sixteenth, you said.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thursday the sixteenth, sir, at two of the clock. Bring your bench, if a bench is what you argue from.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a question in a play, sir. Take it to the moot. I have an entrance. The entrance is not a judgment.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let him take it. Remuneration is the word that pays the stair, and the king is the word that filled it. Go and be Navarre before they invent a third play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go on, Will. I will keep the door a minute. Thou hast the vowels. I have Berowne. I want a house that is listening to the comedy it paid for.

speaker: margery_pell
text: If another man asks for the king, I will tell him the king was Tuesday, and that the Thursday they wrote down has turned into this comedy, and that the next king is the sixteenth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell him that. The company's answer is the one I gave. Abel has the book. I am going up to be Navarre.
